screens.name: FiatAccountDetailsPage
screens.description: Wallet account details (opened with "See details" from Account list). CONFIRMED from codegen: username + status badge, Copy button, fields Account Type / Balance / Registration date / User type, "Freeze account" button (tooltip "Only suspended accounts can ..."), stat cards Total amount deposited / Highest deposit / Lowest deposit / Total amount withdrawn, "Transactions summary", a native <select> "By transaction type" (all / cash_in / cash_out) plus a "Manual Operations" button, Export, reload, Filters (Transaction status, Payment method, Amount range, Date range), rows with "See details". Clicking Freeze on an active account shows "Only suspended accounts can be unfrozen." (snapshot 13 Oct 2026). Stat values sit in the element right after their label, amounts in XAF.

screens.name: FiatManualOperationPage
screens.description: Full-page Manual deposit / Manual withdrawal / Complete transaction flow (Figma 338:10592, 441:12847, 2098:143942). CONFIRMED from snapshots (13 Oct 2026): - URLs /fiat/accounts/<id>/manual-deposit and /manual-withdrawal; entering Review gives /manual-<kind>/<uuid>/verify. - Banner: breadcrumb text ("/ ... / Manual Deposit"), "Do you need help?", and an unnamed close (X) button. Stepper is the <aside> (complementary). - Deposit: "* Deposit Amount", "* Payment Method" (Cash / Mobile Money), "* Payment Operator", "* Payment Reference", "* Reason". - Withdrawal: "Withdrawal amount", switch "Empty entire account", "* Payment method", "* Payment operator", "* Reason of the operation", switches "Automatic fees calculation" / "Charge subscription fees". - Footer: Cancel + Review details, then Back + Confirm deposit/withdrawal.

actions.description: Opens an Ant select and returns its option texts (dropdown left open).

Confirm + OTP (if asked). Moves money: callers must check requireMoneyOps(). Returns whether an OTP was asked for.

screens.name: ManualOperationFlow
screens.description: Manual deposit flow. CONFIRMED on Savings box account details (codegen 29 Sep 2026): "Manual Operations" -> "Deposit" -> "* Deposit Amount" + "* Reason" -> "Review details" (Client, Amount, Date, Payment reference, Reason, alert) -> "Confirm deposit" -> 6-box OTP -> "Deposit processed successfully". Cancel / Back buttons exist on the form and review steps. Withdrawal is INFERRED to mirror this ("Withdraw", "* Withdrawal Amount").

actions.description: Confirms the deposit with the OTP: real money moves (PHX_ALLOW_MONEY_OPS=true, testbox only).

screens.name: AppShell
screens.description: Sidebar + top bar. CONFIRMED from codegen: groups are buttons inside the <nav>; pages are links. Dashboard and User management are top-level links. Link names repeat across groups ("Account list", "Transactions"), so a link is always resolved as the first matching link AFTER its group button. INFERRED: whether a group button carries aria-expanded. If it doesn't, we click the group only when its link isn't already visible. TODO (Rose): send the URL of each page - direct goto() is faster and more robust than clicking through the sidebar.

actions.description: CONFIRMED (snapshot, 2 Oct 2026): the sidebar is an ACCORDION - only one group's links are shown at a time, and clicking a group button toggles it (and may also navigate to the group's first page). So: if the wanted link isn't visible, click the group; if it's still not visible (we just collapsed an open group), click once more. Then click the visible link.

CONFIRMED from snapshots (13 Oct 2026): - main: "Back to account list", tab buttons "Overview" / "Payment Methods" / "Security" (Figma: "Products overview" / "Payment methods" / "Security"), product cards with level-3 headings, status banner paragraph ("This account has been deactivated!" / "frozen!" / "deleted!"). - profile panel = the <aside> (complementary) INSIDE main: initials, name, status word + username, "Copy", "Edit details" (opens a listbox with options "Email address" / "Phone number"), "Change user type" [disabled], "..."
